title: Stoke Space footer
description: A black footer on a 12-column grid: a light 'get in touch' line and a frosted contact button left, compact link columns right, then a giant edge-to-edge wordmark beside a small badge and a tracked uppercase address. A dusk gradient (blue to violet to magenta to orange) rises from below as the footer scrolls in; the contact button's border shimmers while hovered.
notes: best as the page's last section: the gradient finishes rising when the page reaches its end
the rise uses CSS scroll-driven animation; browsers without it show the gradient in place
